description: This file implements a utility function for executing system commands via popen, capturing their output, and handling logging and error reporting. It provides functions for executing commands with formatted arguments, retrieving output buffers, exit codes, and handling different execution flags.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec_xv(char ** buffer,int * len,int * exit_code,int flags,char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Executes a command with formatted arguments, capturing its output, handling logging, and reporting exit status.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec_x(char ** buffer,int * len,int * exit_code,int flags,char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Wrapper around `os_cmd_exec_xv` to execute a command with variadic arguments.

methods.name: bool os_cmd_exec(char ** buffer,char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Simpler wrapper to execute a command with formatted string arguments, capturing output.
